question: Why is it important to jog lightly before playing? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! Warming up gets our body ready to move and play safely! 🏃

question: What does stretching do to our muscles? 💪
explanation: Super! Stretching makes our muscles long and flexible so we can reach far! 💪

question: What is moving our body to a music beat called? 🎶
explanation: Great job! Rhythmic movement is dancing and stepping nicely to the music! 🎶

question: Which exercise opens your arms and legs wide like a star? ⭐
explanation: Awesome! Jumping jacks make us look like bright stars while getting healthy! ⭐

question: What should we do to cool down after playing? 🌬️
explanation: Super! Deep breathing helps our fast heartbeat slow down nicely! 🌬️

question: Walking perfectly on a straight line tests our what? 📏
explanation: Great job! Balance keeps us steady so we do not fall over! ⚖️

question: Standing steady on one foot is like which bird? 🦩
explanation: Awesome! Flamingos are super good at balancing on just one leg! 🦩
hint: It is a tall pink bird.

question: Taking small, quick steps helps us improve our what? ⚡
explanation: Super! Agility means we can move our feet very fast and change direction! ⚡
hint: It means moving fast and easily.

question: How should our feet land when we jump down? 🦘
explanation: Great job! Landing softly on our toes protects our bones from hurting! 🪶

question: Moving side to side instead of forward is called what? ↔️
explanation: Awesome! Side stepping makes us move sideways just like a funny crab! 🦀

question: What action helps us keep a steady beat with music? 🥁
explanation: Super! Clapping hands is a fun way to feel the rhythm and beat! 👏
hint: You use two hands to make sound.

question: When you lift your knees high to your chest, it is called? 🦵
explanation: Great job! High knees is a super exercise to make our legs very strong! 🦵
hint: The name tells you to lift them up.

question: Which body part helps us balance when walking on a narrow beam? 💪
explanation: Awesome! Spreading our arms wide helps us balance like an airplane! ✈️
hint: They stick out from your shoulders.

question: What do we call a slow, relaxing walk after a fast run? 🚶
explanation: Super! A cool down walk lets our body relax nicely after working hard! 🚶

question: Touching your toes with your fingers helps stretch your what? 🦵
explanation: Great job! Toe touches are wonderful for stretching the back of our legs! 🦵

question: Skipping with a rope is a great way to practice what? 🪢
explanation: Awesome! Skipping rope makes our jumps very quick and perfectly timed! 🪢
hint: You go up and down over the rope.

question: What should we drink after sweating in a fun game? 💧
explanation: Super! Clean water hydrates our body and makes us feel fresh again! 💧

question: Marching on the spot is a wonderful way to do what? 💂
explanation: Great job! Marching gets our blood flowing and warms us up nicely! 💂
hint: It gets you ready to play.

question: What happens to our heartbeat when we run fast? ❤️
explanation: Awesome! Our heart beats faster to pump healthy blood all over our body! ❤️

question: Taking slow, deep breaths brings what into our body? 🌬️
explanation: Super! Deep breaths fill our lungs with lovely fresh air and oxygen! 🌬️
hint: It is all around us outside.

question: Dancing to a happy song keeps our body what? 💃
explanation: Great job! Dancing is a fun exercise that keeps us fit and super happy! 💃
hint: It makes you strong and fit.

question: What does having good posture mean? 🧍
explanation: Awesome! Keeping our back straight helps our spine grow strong and healthy! 📏
hint: You stand up tall and proud.

question: Bending side to side helps us stretch our what? 🧍
explanation: Super! Side bends make our waist nice and flexible for sports! 🔄
hint: It is the middle part of your body.

question: Doing little jumps makes our what strong? 🦴
explanation: Great job! Jumping sends a signal to our bones to grow very strong! 🦴
hint: They are the hard parts inside you.

question: Which fun game needs very quick feet to kick? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! Football players use agility and quick feet to score goals! ⚽
hint: You play it on a big green field.

question: Why must we wear proper sports shoes when playing? 👟
explanation: Super! Good sports shoes give our feet grip and keep us safe from falling! 👟

question: Which exercise looks like sitting on an invisible chair? 🪑
explanation: Great job! Squats make our leg muscles super strong and powerful! 🏋️
hint: You bend your knees and go low.

question: Making big circles with our arms warms up our what? 🔄
explanation: Awesome! Arm circles keep our shoulder joints flexible and ready to throw! 🔄

question: Moving your feet nicely to a 1-2-3 count is called what? 🔢
explanation: Super! Stepping to a count helps us dance perfectly to the music! 🎶

question: What helps us stop safely without tumbling down? 🛑
explanation: Great job! Good balance acts like brakes so we can stop safely! 🛑
hint: It keeps you steady on your feet.

question: Walking quietly on our tiptoes makes which body part strong? 🦶
explanation: Awesome! Tiptoe walking gives our feet and lower legs a great workout! 🦶
hint: It is the bottom part of your leg.

question: What is a fun, short jump on just one foot called? 🦘
explanation: Super! Hopping on one foot is a super fun way to practice our balance! 🐇

question: Doing daily stretches helps us avoid what during play? 🤕
explanation: Great job! Stretchy muscles are safe muscles that rarely get hurt! 💪
hint: It keeps away boo-boos and pain.

question: What happens when we gently twist our body left and right? 🔄
explanation: Awesome! Twisting keeps our back and spine very happy and flexible! 🦴

question: Jumping up and turning in the air is called what? 🌀
explanation: Super! Spin jumps are amazing acrobatic moves that look so cool! 🌀
hint: You rotate while in the air.

question: Which muscles are most important when we kick a ball? 🦵
explanation: Great job! Our leg muscles give the power to kick the ball super far! 🦵

question: Which playground game involves hopping on drawn squares? 🟩
explanation: Awesome! Hopscotch is a brilliant game to practice hopping and balancing! 🟩
hint: You toss a stone and hop.

question: Wiggling our toes inside our shoes helps to warm up our what? 🦶
explanation: Super! Little toe wiggles wake up our feet before we start running! 🦶
hint: They are at the end of your legs.

question: A happy, fast-paced walk to stay healthy is called what? 🚶
explanation: Great job! A brisk walk is a super simple way to keep our heart very strong! 🚶

question: Reaching high to touch the sky stretches our what? 🌤️
explanation: Awesome! Reaching high is a wonderful full-body stretch to start the day! 🧍

question: Rolling our neck in slow, gentle circles helps us do what? 😌
explanation: Super! Gentle neck rolls release tiredness and make us feel very relaxed! 😌

question: Before making a huge jump, what must we do? 🦘
explanation: Great job! Bending knees acts like a spring to shoot us up high into the air! 🦘

question: What are the best kinds of clothes for jumping and exercising? 👕
explanation: Awesome! Loose clothes let our body move freely in any direction! 👕
hint: They give you room to stretch.

question: Sweating a lot during playtime shows that our body is what? 💦
explanation: Super! Sweat is our body's clever way of cooling down when we work hard! 💦

question: Doing aerobic exercises with classmates helps us make what? 🤝
explanation: Great job! Playing and exercising together is the best way to make lovely friends! 🤝

question: Touching your right knee with your left hand is what kind of step? 🔀
explanation: Awesome! Cross steps are great for making our brain and body work together! 🔀

question: What animal walks on four legs and helps us stretch if we copy it? 🐈
explanation: Super! The cat stretch is a wonderful yoga pose that makes our back feel great! 🐈

question: Stepping carefully on stepping stones tests our what? 🪨
explanation: Great job! Stepping exactly on the stones trains our eyes and feet to work as a team! 🪨
hint: You have to look and stay steady.

question: Throwing and catching a soft ball helps our hands and what work together? ⚾
explanation: Awesome! Playing catch gives us super hand-eye coordination! ⚾
hint: You need them to see the ball.

question: How should we feel after a fun session of Little Steps aerobics? 😊
explanation: Super! Exercise makes magic happy chemicals in our brain so we feel amazing! 😊
